response.justification: Bogdan is a skilled, senior-level software engineer with strong fundamentals and excellent communication abilities, but lacks the critical mandatory requirements for this capital markets role. Most critically, he has minimal C++ experience (approximately 6 months in 2014-2015, now 11+ years outdated) and zero experience in capital markets, fixed income, or financial services domains. There is no mention of Windows platform specialization, SQL Server/Oracle expertise, or any relevant financial industry exposure. While his software engineering practices and seniority level are positive attributes, they cannot offset the absence of both core technical skills and domain knowledge that are explicitly required.
strengths: Excellent verbal and written communication demonstrated through workshops, talks, and open-source project leadership
Strong software engineering fundamentals with proven expertise in CI/CD, testing practices, and architectural design
Senior/Staff-level seniority matching required level with demonstrated ability to mentor others and lead technical initiatives
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and severely outdated (last documented work in 2014-2015, approximately 6 months of dedicated development)
No experience in capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or any financial services domain
No evidence of Windows platform expertise, SQL Server/Oracle proficiency, or STL knowledge; career trajectory focused entirely on web/mobile/embedded systems
